provenance.dataset_title: BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems
provenance.acquisition_method: Connected GitHub github_fetch_blob returns authoritative UTF-8 content by Git blob SHA; full content processed programmatically without model transcription.
provenance.raw_retention_note: Full raw CSV was fetched into tool orchestration memory and aggregated directly; remote immutable source blob + SHA256 retained. Reacquire via GitHub blob or ordinary public download and run prepare_burstgpt.py to reproduce.
provenance.attribution: Yuxin Wang et al., BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems, KDD 2025, DOI 10.1145/3711896.3737413.
provenance.native_time_unit: seconds from local first-day midnight; absolute date/timezone not supplied in CSV
provenance.timestamp_semantics: Request submission, not completion or billing time
provenance.transformation: All source rows retained for parsing and full-source QA; input+output sums grouped by floor(timestamp/3600). Canonical field named total_tokens contains SUM OF INPUT TOKENS ONLY across all models/logtypes; target_meter=input_tokens. Exclude first and last bins containing trace bounds; keep complete interior [3600,5266800). Fill 36 empty interior bins zero under observed-release coverage assumption. No scaling, resampling, detrending, currency conversion, fabricated team/user assignment or shifted calendar dates.
provenance.target_semantics: Recorded request input tokens assigned to submission-time bin; input length is known at submission, reducing final-output availability leakage. This is serving input workload proxy, not invoice spending.
provenance.coverage_assumption: IDEALIZED: trace release is treated as observed request stream throughout interior span; no per-bin provider completeness/outage metadata supplied. Empty bins describe no recorded requests, not verified no real demand.
provenance.availability_assumption: IDEALIZED: preceding bins treated as observed at origin. Input length known at submission, but original export lacks capture/receipt/maturity histories, so end-to-end historical acquisition availability remains unverified.
provenance.privacy_identity: No users, teams, projects, accounts, organizations or sessions in actual source CSV. Model+Log Type cohorts are workload cohorts only. Newer README mentions Session ID and Elapsed time but those columns are absent from immutable /data asset used here.
provenance.failure_handling: 25,443 rows with zero response tokens retained; authors identify these as failures, which may still involve input usage and do not establish billing treatment.
provenance.seasonality_prior: Pinned README labels daily and weekly periodicity figures; fixed 24-bin daily seasonal-naive comparator may be declared before final evaluation, without choosing lag on final outcomes.
limitations: One anonymized Azure-backed workload stream; not representative enterprise team spend or prospective accuracy.
Single fixed hindsight export cannot validate the production bitemporal ingestion gates.
Hourly horizons are1hour/4hours; do not relabel bins as days or claim weekly/monthly planning performance.
No provider-reported monetary target or actual model deployment version; coarse ChatGPT/GPT-4 names cannot establish historical tariff.
Pretrained model may have trained on public historical trace; contamination cannot be ruled out without model training provenance.
provenance.retrospective_secondary_target: burstgpt_hourly_tokens.csv is total input+eventual output attributed to submission time; use only as hindsight secondary.

procedure_manifest.fit_policy: zero-shot pretrained, joint residual fit per origin on prefix only
